build_benchmarks: build opt and counters microbenchmarks for gRPC using make with a unique build name
run_bm_build_cli: run the bm_build script with a name flag to build named benchmark binaries
build_benchmarks_no_counters: build only opt benchmarks by passing the --no-counters flag to bm_build
build_specific_benchmarks: build specific benchmark tests by passing benchmark names with the -b flag
review_build_function: review the build function that compiles benchmarks and renames the bins directory
